item.title: Netorare no Gakuen ~Mawaru Sacrifice~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FlyingShine Black
  • 発売日: 2012-09-28
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 寝取られの学園 ～輪廻るサクリファイス～
  • 英語名: Netorare no Gakuen Mawaru Sacrifice

别名

  • 寝取られの学園 ～輪廻（まわ）るサクリファイス～

あらすじ

Rokudo is a school city that gathers all the necessary facilities on one island, with Rokudo Academy at its center.

There is no cell phone reception and no internet. Everyone lives in dormitories provided by Rokudo.

While it feels like it’s been left behind by modern times, it has a laid-back atmosphere that you won’t find in the city. However, it’s a slightly unusual island with various rules.

别名

  • Kurai Mirai 4

あらすじ

The newspaper club is about to close down because they always make troubles. Members of the club have a talk, and arrive at a conclusion. The problem is their money waste, so they decide to earn money by themselves. Ayame knows it, and plans to add Masaki to her collection. It is necessary to remove other members at first…. Ayame offers them good part-time jobs at a restaurant and maid cafe. But they are actually owned by her relatives, and she doesn’t tell them what’s going on inside…

别名

  • Kanojo Tachi no Kinki

あらすじ

Yoshiki Saito is an 11th grader who is a kind, popular, intelligent, athletic youth. His good name and reputation will soon be held suspect when he becomes hypnotized by one of his own teachers. Not only is the teacher perverted enough to use our hero as a sex slave, but she sends him to acquire schoolgirls as more sex slaves for her amusement. How willing will these new students be to this erotic double life?

item.title: Inaho no Mirai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FlyingShine Black
  • 発売日: 2006-04-28

  • 日本語名: イナホノミライ
  • 英語名: Inaho no Mirai

别名

  • ミライシリーズ・パック

あらすじ

People receive a “Future Mail” that prophesies what will happen to them without advance notice. The contents of the mail are the prophesy of near future and that always comes true. “Future Mail” is sent seven days straight so that if people take advantage of this mail, it is possible to succeed in life. On the other hand, if the prophesy doesn’t come true, receivers are destined to pass away. Inaho comes back to her alma mater for ten days as a training teacher after an interval of three years. She enjoys her life at school with old friends and teachers. However her peaceful life changes…

In a desperate situation, two sisters strive to survive.

The Shōwa period has just begun.
